title: Local Butcher
summary: Ask for custom cuts and trimming — they know the animal.
origins: Local food sourcing connects cooks to seasonality, community, and often better flavor per dollar when buying peak produce.
history: Call ahead for holiday roasts and special cuts.
teaching: Ask for custom cuts and trimming — they know the animal.
Bones and trim often cheap or free for stock.
Many butchers dry-age or source local farms — ask provenance.
